record.question: EDTA (Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) tubes are used for:
record.explanation: Answer C: Complete blood count. EDTA chelates calcium and prevents clotting in whole-blood tubes; EDTA lavender-top specimens are standard for complete blood counts, while coagulation testing generally uses citrate. Reference: https://wwwn.cdc.gov/nchs/data/nhanes/public/2021/manuals/2021-Laboratory-Procedures-508.pdf; https://lab.waikatodhb.health.nz/test-guide/view/230/complete-blood-count. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
